title: Pizzatier tagger mod
description: Live PvP tier rankings from PizzaTiers, shown on every nametag.
body:
# 🍕 PizzaTiers — TierTagger

**See PvP tier rankings from the [PizzaTiers](https://discord.gg/RdkHDtwkFq) Discord directly on player nametags in-game.** When a tester closes your test on Discord, your tier updates instantly everywhere — tab list, nametags, the player profile screen.

This is a fork of the open-source [TierTagger](https://github.com/mctiers-dev/TierTagger) mod, repointed at the PizzaTiers ranking backend with custom Crystal-themed icons.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔮 **Tier on every nametag** — see anyone's tier instantly when they appear on your screen
- 📊 **Player profile lookup** — search any player for their full ranking history
- 🎨 **Custom PizzaTiers icons** for every gamemode (Crystal, Sword, Axe, Mace, Pot, NethPot, UHC, SMP)
- ⚡ **Live sync** — updates the moment a tester closes your test on Discord, no game restart needed
- 🌐 **Works everywhere** — visible on every server, not just PizzaTiers
- 🛡️ **Lightweight** — purely client-side, no server installation required

---

## 🚀 How to use

1. **Install the mod** — pick the right jar for your Minecraft version (see table below) and drop it in your mods folder
2. **Join the [PizzaTiers Discord](https://discord.gg/RdkHDtwkFq)**
3. **Run `/link <your Minecraft username>`** in Discord to connect your accounts — you'll instantly get the **Verified** role
4. **Get tested** — request a Crystal PvP tier test from a PizzaTiers tester
5. **Done** 🎉 — your tier appears on your nametag in-game for everyone running this mod

---

## 📦 Version compatibility

| Minecraft version | Use this jar |
|---|---|
| 1.21 / 1.21.1 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.jar` |
| 1.21.2 / 1.21.3 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.2.jar` |
| 1.21.4 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.4.jar` |
| 1.21.5 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.5.jar` |
| 1.21.6 / 1.21.7 / 1.21.8 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.6.jar` |
| 1.21.9 / 1.21.10 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.9.jar` |
| 1.21.11 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 | `PizzaTiers-TierTagger-mc26.1.jar` |

---

## 🧩 Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** (0.16+)
- **Fabric API**
- **[ukulib](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukulib)** — required for the config screen

> ⚠️ This mod is **client-side only**. You don't need it on the server, and it won't connect you to PizzaTiers — that's what the Discord linking step is for.

---

## 🔗 Server & Community

- 🎮 **Minecraft server**: `pizzatiers.net`
- 💬 **Discord**: [discord.gg/RdkHDtwkFq](https://discord.gg/RdkHDtwkFq)

Come hop in the Discord to get tested, hang out, or just check the leaderboards. 🍕
